def junctions(G):
    fill, sr, sc, J = analyze(G)
    sepcol = J[0][0]  # representative sep color? better: detect sep color
    # sep color: the color of the full lines excluding marks = the value that appears on sep lines
    from collections import Counter
    line_vals = Counter(G[r][c] for r in sr for c in range(len(G[0])))
    # marks = values on sep lines not equal to most common line value? sep color is most common on lines
    sep = line_vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    M = [[v if v != sep else None for v in row] for row in J]
    marks = [r for r,row in enumerate(M) if any(v is not None for v in row)]
    markc = [c for c in range(len(M[0])) if any(M[r][c] is not None for r in range(len(M)))]
    return fill, sep, [ [M[r][c] for c in markc] for r in marks ]

def rule_strict(M, fill):
    R,C = len(M)-1, len(M[0])-1
    out=[[fill]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            cs=[M[i][j],M[i][j+1],M[i+1][j],M[i+1][j+1]]
            if cs[0] is not None and len(set(cs))==1: out[i][j]=cs[0]
